schedule.note: Routine is set in Central time so daylight-saving changes are handled automatically.

ingredients: cream sauces (heavy cream, alfredo, cream-based pan sauces)

food_safety.thermometer: Use an instant-read thermometer for chicken and pork.

shopping.premium_channel: Whole Foods (optional, for steak, shrimp, and seafood)
shopping.note: Nothing is ordered automatically. Dawn edits the checklist before ordering.

delivery.method: Outlook (Microsoft 365) send_mail with the HTML body
delivery.duplicate_check: Search Sent Items for the same subject before sending
delivery.on_failure: Save the HTML and report the exact error. Do not disable the schedule.
delivery.status: Pending: test send and Sent Items verification, then owner confirmation
